title: 21_Road_Rules
main_characters: Once we hop this fence, we'll be right outside Silas Prince's top secret garage.

pick_word.subtitle: Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!
Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!
Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Should Linda date Kenji or Howard?

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Megan wins!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Tomorrow, she'll race against Tom Prince in the `Final Round!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tomorrow, she'll race against Tom Prince in the [i]Final Round![/i]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji...?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I guess Kenji didn't stick around after the race. He must be upset about losing.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'd really like to talk with him, but...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I have to get ready for tomorrow.
Two days later, after the Prince Prix has ended...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, Megan...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You probably heard the news by now.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I lost to Tom Prince.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Anyway, I was just thinking that if you wanted to team up again next year... I'd really like that.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Or we could just hang out sometime. Maybe work on some engines together.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: If you feel like it, give me a call.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Okay, so... Talk to you soon.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: First Kenji breaks up our team over some stupid girl who doesn't even like him like that...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Then he beats me in front of everybody...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And now he wants to hang out?!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Grrr!!
Well, that wasn't the best possible ending, was it?
Megan lost the race against Kenji and lost his friendship to boot!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can take home the Prince Cup!

nodes.text: After the race...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji...?

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Kenji wins!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Tomorrow, he'll race against Tom Prince in the `Final Round!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tomorrow, he'll race against Tom Prince in the [i]Final Round![/i]

nodes.text: The next morning, at Prince Racetrack...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back to the second round of the competition.

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Today, two former allies go head to head.

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Only one will advance to the final round and race against Prince Automotive's top driver... Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Will it be Megan?

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Or will it be Kenji?
At the starting line, the two young racers approach one another...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji, I still don't understand why you broke up the team...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And I'm mad as heck that only one of us gets to go on to the final round...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But I want you to know that I respect your decision.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Wow, Megan...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: The truth is... I miss being on your team, too.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Then why'd you quit?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm riding on my own this year because...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Because, I...
Just then, a voice calls out from the stands...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kenji! Over here!
Kenji and Megan turn to see... Linda and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good luck, Kenji!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard, aren't you forgetting something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now that Linda and I are official, I guess it doesn't hurt to be the bigger man.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, like she said... Break your legs! Err... I mean, just one leg. I mean, good luck!
Kenji waves back to Linda... He puts on his best smile...
But, up close, Kenji looks utterly heartbroken.
Without another word...
Kenji storms over to his car.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I get it now!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I've been so focused on the race, I didn't see what was right in front of me!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Two months ago, Linda started dating Howard.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji must've entered the race on his own to try to impress her!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's why he's been so focused on winning!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Racers, take your positions!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Now I know why Kenji broke up the team, but it doesn't change anything.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I came here to win!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Megan zooms toward the finish line!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: But Kenji is coming up fast!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: It's `neck and neck` and...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [i]neck and neck[/i] and...

rounds.subtitle: Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!
Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji, I've wanted your help from the very beginning!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sure, the `driver` is important. But so is the `car.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, the [color=#3b78e2][i]driver[/i][/color] is important. But so is the [color=#3b78e2][i]car.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: That's why we made such a great team!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Megan, there's something I need to confess.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I thought maybe if I won the Prince Prix on my own, Linda might realize her mistake and dump Howard.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's why I broke up the team!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But that isn't how relationships work.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And by trying so hard to make Linda like me, I lost sight of how important our friendship is!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Megan, if you still want my help...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, duh. I'm here, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Now get to work, slacker! I'm not paying you to mope around!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: First, we trade out your exhaust system!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Then we add some block tread tires!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Finally, we install a tank of nitro under the hood for maximum acceleration!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I was worried all these changes might ruin my classic car!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But she's prettier than ever!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Now I'm definitely ready for the big race!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Our partnership meant everything to me...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And you tossed me aside because you wanted to impress some dumb preppy?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Megan, I...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And who's to say it wouldn't happen again?! In fact, just thinking about it makes me `angry!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And who's to say it wouldn't happen again?! In fact, just thinking about it makes me [color=#3b78e2][i]angry![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I really oughtta punch your lights out!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Help like that I do not need!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Wait, Megan!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Eat my exhaust, jerk!

nodes.speaker: ENGINE
nodes.text: VROOOMM!!!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hack! Cough!
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji, there you are!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I've been driving all over looking for you!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I know we haven't seen eye to eye on this race, but I really need your help to beat Tom Prince.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: After everything I did, you still want my help?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Tell you what...
Megan tries to say 'no'... But instead she says...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're right! Everyone does have a price.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And I think you just met mine!
Tom Prince flashes a twisted, self-important sneer.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Victory is mine!!!
At the racetrack the following morning...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What happened out there, Megan?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: It looked like you weren't even trying!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Who says I was, shrimp?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hey, is that a new vest?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And a new MP3 Player?
But it didn't stop at just one race...
Megan quickly found herself 'selling out' at every possible opportunity...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Megan, many racing fans out there want to know why a girl with your history of `integrity...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Megan, many racing fans out there want to know why a girl with your history of [i]integrity...[/i]

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Would promote an automobile with such a terrible safety record?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sure, sometimes the fuel tanks spontaneously combust...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But Prince Automotive gave me an awful lot of money to say how awesome these cars are!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So forget what anybody else says. You should go buy one!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Heck, why not buy two?!
Until years later, on her deathbed...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Megan. There's nothing we can do.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I hear you, Doc.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: So... Cough... How much do you want?

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: I'm sorry... How much do I want for what?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Cough!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: How much is it going to cost me to get to the top of the transplant list?

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: I'm afraid it doesn't work that way, Megan.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: There are some things you just can't buy.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: You're going to have to wait your turn like everyone else.
That's not a very happy ending!
Looks like 'selling out' isn't the path to ultimate happiness!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can get a better ending than that!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Tell you what...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Keep your money!
Megan hurls the envelope at Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it! Papercuts hurt!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Looks like the rumors were true, Tom! You are a cheater!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't put this all on me! The bribe was my dad's idea!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I could outrace you and that bucket of bolts if I were driving a rusty wheelbarrow!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Really? If that's true...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Then how come your father is trying to buy me out?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Shut up!
Tom storms across the street to the orphanage...
And flies off in his helicopter!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Tom Prince may be a cheat, but he was right about one thing...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: My car will need a major upgrade if I'm going to hold my own against that PRATT.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're right, Spike! I love making documentaries.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And if sneaking around is what I need to do to get my big scoop...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Then that's exactly what I'll do!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What would've happened if Rob Windward had been afraid of parking garages...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Or Huntley Z. Tompkins had been scared of anthropomorphic desert creatures...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Or if Perry Radisson had been afraid to doodle crude obscenities on pictures of celebrities!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yes, Spike... I have the internet, too.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But forget all that. Let's do this!
Spike boosts Mallika over the top of the barb-wire fence and...
She's in!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Come on, Spike! I hear voices coming from inside the top secret garage!
Meanwhile, inside Silas Prince's Top Secret Garage...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I just don't see what you're so worried about, Dad.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Megan is driving a '69 Fjord Anaconda. A car like that belongs in a museum, not on a racetrack.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There's no way she can outrace the PRATT.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Do I need to remind you that Megan defeated Kenji today? And he was driving a 2010 Monsoon Ultima!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Only a fool would underestimate Megan!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Son, I can't emphasize enough how important it is that we win that race tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: After your ill-considered dalliance with the Flex-Games...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: The Prince family name has been associated with losers like Skazz.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Now, we must prove to the public that Prince Automotive makes the very best cars in the world...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Even if we have to `cheat` to do it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even if we have to [color=#e23b3b][i]cheat[/i][/color] to do it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huh?
Outside, just beneath the window...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoops! I need to remember to keep quiet!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Dad, did you hear something?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Only the sound of my blood boiling over with rage!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Here! Take this envelope to Megan. You know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Meanwhile, I'll install the 'secret weapon' into your vehicle.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay. I'm on it.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: And, son...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Don't forget... This race is your last chance to prove you aren't a loser. Don't screw it up!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Now, to begin.
As Tom Prince exits the garage...
Silas installs a mysterious computer into the dashboard of the PRATT.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika, are you getting all this on tape?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Every last devious second. This footage could even win me a Howitzer!
Later that night, at the Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How quaint!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: A driver tuning up her own automobile!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Tom Prince? I didn't see you drive up!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's because I didn't 'drive'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The only time you'll ever find me behind the wheel is when I'm winning races!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My chauffuer flew me here via helicopter.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He's currently double-parked on the roof of the orphanage across the street.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Well, whatever you're doing, you shouldn't be here! I'm prepping for tomorrow's race!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Why bother? You're going to lose anyway.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You sure do seem confident.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I should be.
Tom hands Megan an envelope. Inside, Megan finds five thousand dollars.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This is money!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... Is it?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You want to `bribe` me to throw the race?
nodes.text_bbcode: You want to [color=#3b78e2][i]bribe[/i][/color] me to throw the race?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'Bribe' is such a dirty word. Why not think of it as 'payment for services rendered'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Only, in this case, the 'service' is humiliating yourself in front of your family and friends...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That is... If you actually have any friends.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And what makes you think I'll accept your 'payment'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because everybody has a price.
Megan eyes the crisp hundred dollar bills.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This is more money than I've ever seen in one place my entire life! I should...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure! All the best empty swimming pools are in back yards.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: If you want to maximize your trick time, you need to get comfortable hopping fences.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike! I didn't realize you were such an expert!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I don't know about expert, but I guess I did pick up a few tricks trying to perfect my blunt to fakie.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is this...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I learned how to hop fences because it was the only way I could do what I loved.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Really? Nothing?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... Nothing but armed guards, trained attack dogs, laser motion detectors...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Think about it... The Prince family is really wealthy. I'm sure they have top-notch security.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And, if we do end up getting caught, you can bet they'll press charges!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike... I'm not sure this is helping.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is this...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: If you really want to do an expose on Prince Automotive, none of that should make a difference.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You'll do whatever it takes!
Later that night, the investigation begins...

nodes.character: Once we hop this fence, we'll be right outside Silas Prince's top secret garage.

nodes.text: What's the matter, Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm not sure we should do this...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But this was your idea!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I know. I guess I'm not very comfortable with all of this sneaking around.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What happens if we get caught... Or arrested?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Jeez, Mallika really looks freaked out. I need to say something that'll calm her down.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll tell her...

options.label: I do this all the time.

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Megan wins!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Tom Prince wins!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: What a heartbreaker, folks!

nodes.speaker: P.R.A.T.T.
nodes.text: Course plotted!

nodes.speaker: P.R.A.T.T.
nodes.text: Accelerating!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: It looks like Tom Prince is gaining ground!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: After a rocky start, his technique has markedly improved...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: It's almost as if a `computer` were driving for him! But, of course, that's not what's happening...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's almost as if a [i]computer[/i] were driving for him! But, of course, that's not what's happening...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Because that would be a clear violation of the rules. Right, Silas?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Err... Of course!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: You know my son... Honest to a fault!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Of course, if he hadn't bungled that bribe...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: He wouldn't have needed to use the 'secret weapon' in the first place.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look, Spike, Tom Prince is using the secret weapon!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: This will make great footage for my documentary!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know I was rooting for Megan to win the race, but my film has to take top priority.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And, besides, there was nothing I could do to stop Tom Prince...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...Or was there?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'll give you this much, Megan...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You've got a lot of guts racing me in that old junk heap.

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Racers, take your positions!

rounds.subtitle: Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!
Drive fast! Don't hit the brakes!

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back to the `final round` of the Prince Prix...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back to the [i]final round[/i] of the Prince Prix...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: And now, let me present our final two contestants...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: First, the reigning champion, Thomas 'Lightning' Prince...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Driving the `Prince Racing Automobile Two Thousand!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Driving the [i]Prince Racing Automobile Two Thousand!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Versus challenger, Megan...

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Driving a `'69 Fjord Anaconda!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Driving a [i]'69 Fjord Anaconda!!![/i]

nodes.speaker: Sportscaster
nodes.text: Let's hear it for these two great drivers, people!!!

nodes.speaker: CROWD
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Host
nodes.text: Everyone give `Mallika` a big round of applause. Her film is called...
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone give [i]Mallika[/i] a big round of applause. Her film is called...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Cease!

nodes.speaker: Host
nodes.text: Officer, what is the meaning of this?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I have a signed court order prohibiting the screening of this picture.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What?! Why?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Apparently, some of the footage in the film may have been obtained by a person or persons trespassing on private property.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That means they were 'sneaking around'.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Until such time as the matter can be resolved, I'm duty-bound to confiscate the material in question.

nodes.speaker: Host
nodes.text: Well, these documents do seem to be in order...

nodes.speaker: Host
nodes.text: Looks like we're going to have to skip this film and move onto our next entry.
Later that night, as the crowd exits the theater...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm sorry nobody got to see your film, Mallika. It was way better than all those other documentaries.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, you would've won for sure.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks, guys. I just can't believe Silas Prince got my movie banned from the festival.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: He had to do it. Your movie would've exposed him for what he is... A cheater.
Just then, a black limousine glides to a stop beside the three friends.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: You know, my mother always used to say, 'Speak of the wolf...'

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: '...And it will be at your door.'

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Silas Prince!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hear to gloat? You won't win. You do know that, right?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Please. I don't need to `win.` All I need to do is make sure your film never sees the light of day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please. I don't need to [color=#e23b3b][i]win.[/i][/color] All I need to do is make sure your film never sees the light of day.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I think my lawyers have that well covered.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: But, judging by your petulant attitude, I'm not sure you children have learned your lesson.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: So maybe this will register...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: As of tonight, Prince Automotive is eliminating all charitable funding for the Centerscore High Auto-Shop.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What?! But we need those parts you donate to keep the Auto-Shop going!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Maybe you girls should've thought of that before you foiled my plans!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Bye, now! Enjoy your victory!
Wow!!! Who could've seen that coming?!
Looks like the kids at Centerscore have opened up a real can of worms! But what happens next?
Come back and find out!
Now that you've beaten this episode, don't forget to play the new Megapack: Homecoming Queen!
It's a battle for the crown between the most popular girls at Centerscore High! Do you have what it takes to beat Paula and become the new Homecoming Queen? Play now to find out!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Now that I've gotten a taste of competition...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Our team is officially over!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sure, I lost this year. But, next year, I'll be back and better than ever!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: See ya!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Wouldn't want to be ya!
Well, that wasn't the best possible ending, was it?
Megan lost the race against Tom Prince...
And her friendship with Kenji to boot!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Huh. After all that...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Looks like Kenji may still have a chance with Linda after all.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: But no time for romance now.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: The team is back together... and we've got races to win!
Look at you! You won the Prince Prix!
Not only that but you also patched things up between Megan and Kenji. Not bad...
In fact, you got a perfect game!
Enjoy this bonus scene!
And then tell us what you think!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: On the contrary, Megan, your lackey sabotaged my 'secret weapon.'

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I beat you fair and square!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm really happy we started working together again.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We didn't win this year...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But next year, Tom Prince doesn't stand a chance!
Well, that wasn't `so` bad, was it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that wasn't [b]so[/b] bad, was it?

nodes.text: Megan may have lost the race, but she did patch things up with Kenji.
